sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, as Venezuela descends further into crisis, its most vocal and beloved opposition leader sits under house arrest, unable to act, and prohibited from speaking out.
sentences.zh: 今天，随着委内瑞拉陷入更深的危机，其最直言不讳、最受爱戴的反对派领袖正处于软禁之中，无法采取行动，也被禁止公开发声。

sentences.en: What happens if he does?
sentences.zh: 如果他这么做了会怎样？

sentences.en: It's Monday,
sentences.zh: 今天是3月12日，

sentences.en: March 12th.
sentences.zh: 星期一。

sentences.en: When Leo Lopez wakes up on a typical day, it's very early.
sentences.zh: 利奥·洛佩兹在平常的一天醒来时，时间非常早。

sentences.en: It's 4.30, 5 o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 大概是凌晨4点半或5点。

sentences.en: It's dark out.
sentences.zh: 外面天还是黑的。

sentences.en: He lives on a leafy street in the suburbs of Caracas.
sentences.zh: 他住在加拉加斯郊区一条绿树成荫的街道上。

sentences.en: And he gets out of bed and pads down to the front door like many people do, opens it, and without going too
sentences.zh: 他起床后像许多人一样走到前门，打开门，并没有走得

sentences.en: far outside, grabs the newspaper, and generally spends the morning in a sort of solitude.
sentences.zh: 太远，拿了报纸，通常会在某种孤独中度过早晨。

sentences.en: But at about seven, goes to wake his two kids, Manuela and Leopoldo Jr.
sentences.zh: 但在七点左右，他会去叫醒他的两个孩子，曼努埃拉和小利奥波多。

sentences.en: He always dresses them, gets their shoes on, makes sure their backpacks are ready.
sentences.zh: 他总是帮他们穿好衣服，穿上鞋子，确保他们的书包准备好了。

sentences.en: And then when it's time for them to head off to school, he and his wife, Lillian, walk the kids to the door.
sentences.zh: 当他们该去上学时，他和妻子莉莲会把孩子们送到门口。

sentences.en: Leo kisses them goodbye, and he can't go with them.
sentences.zh: 利奥吻别他们，但他不能和他们一起走。

sentences.en: So he closes the door behind them and goes back inside.
sentences.zh: 于是他关上门，回到屋里。

sentences.en: But sometimes he'll climb up onto the roof to look out as far as he can.
sentences.zh: 但有时他会爬上屋顶，尽可能地向外眺望。

sentences.en: To the north, he can see El Avila National
sentences.zh: 向北，他可以看到埃尔阿维拉国家

sentences.en: Park, where he used to love to run and cycle and climb.
sentences.zh: 公园，他曾经喜欢在那里跑步、骑车和攀爬。

sentences.en: And then to the south, the street where his family's just departed, which is lined with the secret police from the Venezuelan government to make sure he doesn't leave the house.
sentences.zh: 向南，是他家人刚刚离开的那条街，街上排满了委内瑞拉政府的秘密警察，以确保他不会离开房子。

sentences.en: Will Hilton has been reporting on Leo Lopez for the past six months.
sentences.zh: 威尔·希尔顿在过去六个月里一直在报道利奥·洛佩兹。

sentences.en: Leo Lopez is the most prominent political prisoner in Latin America and possibly the world.
sentences.zh: 利奥·洛佩兹是拉丁美洲乃至全世界最著名的政治犯。

sentences.en: We stand in solidarity with those who are detained at this very moment.
sentences.zh: 我们与此刻被拘留的人们站在一起。

sentences.en: In Venezuela,
sentences.zh: 在委内瑞拉，

sentences.en: Leopoldo Lopez.
sentences.zh: 利奥波多·洛佩兹。

sentences.en: He's sort of the president who never was of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 他算是委内瑞拉那位“未曾当选的总统”。

sentences.en: The United States is deeply concerned that Leopoldo Lopez has been convicted and sentenced on a range of politically motivated charges.
sentences.zh: 美国对利奥波多·洛佩兹因一系列出于政治动机的指控而被定罪和判刑深表关切。

sentences.en: La crise actuelle du Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉当前的危机。

sentences.en: Une dictature tente de se survivre au prix d'une détresse humanitaire sans précédent.
sentences.zh: 一个独裁政权正试图以史无前例的人道主义灾难为代价来维持生存。

sentences.en: You can pretty much go through the list of Western heads of state,
sentences.zh: 你几乎可以列举出西方国家元首的名单，

sentences.en: Emmanuel Macron, Angela Merkel, Theresa May, Justin Trudeau, and everyone has supported him.
sentences.zh: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙、安格拉·默克尔、特蕾莎·梅、贾斯廷·特鲁多，每个人都支持他。

sentences.en: An evening tweet by President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的一条晚间推文。

sentences.en: The message to release jailed opposition leader
sentences.zh: 释放被监禁的反对派领袖

sentences.en: Leopoldo Lopez.
sentences.zh: 利奥波多·洛佩兹的信息。

sentences.en: The sort of perfect example is that both Barack Obama and Donald Trump are in perfect agreement about this particular case, sort of an outlier in all other world affairs.
sentences.zh: 一个完美的例子是，巴拉克·奥巴马和唐纳德·特朗普在这个特定案件上完全一致，这在所有其他世界事务中算是一个异类。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it really seems that the only people who want him in prison are the current regime in
sentences.zh: 而且似乎唯一想让他入狱的人就是委内瑞拉的

sentences.en: Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 现任政权。

sentences.en: Will, who is this man, Leo Lopez?
sentences.zh: 威尔，利奥·洛佩兹是什么人？

sentences.en: Leo Lopez grew up in a wealthy enclave in northeastern Caracas.
sentences.zh: 利奥·洛佩兹在加拉加斯东北部的一个富人区长大。

sentences.en: He was a competitive swimmer.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名竞技游泳运动员。

sentences.en: He loved skateboarding.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢滑板。

sentences.en: He loved bicycling with his cousins in the neighborhood and running around, chasing after girls.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢和表兄弟们在社区里骑自行车，四处奔跑，追逐女孩。

sentences.en: And it was really on a school trip in the early part of high school out into a rural state, an oil producing region of Venezuela,
sentences.zh: 在高中早期的一次学校旅行中，他去了委内瑞拉的一个农村州，一个产油区，

sentences.en: where he told me he was just shocked by the level of poverty that he saw in the barrios out there.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他在那里看到的贫民窟贫困程度让他感到震惊。

sentences.en: And the contrast between the wealth that he knew was underground and the poverty above ground.
sentences.zh: 地下蕴藏的财富与地面上的贫困形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: And that really sort of animated him to become interested in politics at that age.
sentences.zh: 这确实激发了他在那个年纪对政治产生兴趣。

sentences.en: What do you mean by the wealth underground and the poverty above ground?
sentences.zh: 你所说的“地下财富”和“地面贫困”是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, when you think about Venezuela, the most important thing to keep in mind, both politically and economically and to a certain degree socially, is the oil.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你想到委内瑞拉时，无论是在政治、经济还是在某种程度上的社会层面，最需要记住的就是石油。

sentences.en: Venezuela sits on the largest proven oil reserves in the world, larger than Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉拥有世界上已探明的最大石油储量，比沙特阿拉伯还要多。

sentences.en: And so it's the potential beneficiary of this extraordinary wealth.
sentences.zh: 因此，它是这种巨大财富的潜在受益者。

sentences.en: And yet, even under the nominal democracy at the time that Leo was growing up, there was enormous stratification of income.
sentences.zh: 然而，即使在利奥成长时期的名义民主制度下，收入分层也非常严重。

sentences.en: And so this underclass was becoming increasingly frustrated by the distribution of wealth to a very small group of the upper class
sentences.zh: 因此，这个下层阶级对财富分配给极少数上层阶级感到越来越沮丧，

sentences.en: and the abject poverty throughout so much of the country.
sentences.zh: 而全国大部分地区却处于赤贫状态。

sentences.en: Remember, these were really the conditions that led to the popularity in the late 1990s of Hugo Chavez, who was promising in a very forceful way to redistribute
sentences.zh: 请记住，正是这些条件导致了雨果·查韦斯在20世纪90年代末的受欢迎，他以一种非常有力的姿态承诺重新分配

sentences.en: this income from the oil and give more of it to the people.
sentences.zh: 这些石油收入，并将其更多地给予人民。

sentences.en: So when Chavez becomes president in the late
sentences.zh: 所以当查韦斯在20世纪90年代末成为总统时，

sentences.en: 1990s, at the same time, the price of oil is also skyrocketing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，油价也在飙升。

sentences.en: And he is showered with revenue from the state oil company, which he does distribute.
sentences.zh: 他被国家石油公司的收入所淹没，他也确实进行了分配。

sentences.en: He does make good on a lot of these promises.
sentences.zh: 他确实兑现了许多承诺。

sentences.en: Unemployment plunges.
sentences.zh: 失业率骤降。

sentences.en: Income inequality in Venezuela becomes one of the lowest levels in the Western Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉的收入不平等程度成为西半球最低的国家之一。

sentences.en: And the poor love him for it.
sentences.zh: 穷人们因此而爱戴他。

sentences.en: But as the price of oil goes down over the second half of his presidency, he starts to see economic trouble creep in.
sentences.zh: 但随着油价在他总统任期的后半段下跌，他开始看到经济问题悄然而至。

sentences.en: The country was also entering real shortages of food and medicine.
sentences.zh: 这个国家也开始出现严重的食品和药品短缺。

sentences.en: And yet at the same time, Chavez is obliterating democratic institutions, basically, one by one.
sentences.zh: 然而与此同时，查韦斯基本上正在一个接一个地摧毁民主制度。

sentences.en: He's consolidating power.
sentences.zh: 他正在巩固权力。

sentences.en: He's stacking the courts.
sentences.zh: 他正在操纵法院。

sentences.en: He's empowering and emboldening these paramilitary collectivo groups who will take action against anyone who appears to threaten his grip on power.
sentences.zh: 他正在授权并壮大那些准军事组织“集体”（colectivos），他们会对任何威胁到他权力的人采取行动。

sentences.en: So, for example, when organized protests take to the streets, you can expect the paramilitary colectivos to arrive and beat up on the protesters.
sentences.zh: 例如，当有组织的抗议活动走上街头时，你可以预料到准军事组织会赶来殴打抗议者。

sentences.en: And as Leopoldo watches this, he decides that he's going to challenge Chavez for power.
sentences.zh: 当利奥波多看到这一切时，他决定要挑战查韦斯的权力。

sentences.en: So, throughout this time, Leo Lopez is extremely critical of Chavez.
sentences.zh: 因此，在那段时间里，利奥·洛佩兹对查韦斯持极其批评的态度。

sentences.en: And he'd gone to the United
sentences.zh: 他曾去美国上大学，

sentences.en: States for college and became very aware of the traditions of nonviolence.
sentences.zh: 并非常了解非暴力传统。

sentences.en: And Lopez becomes committed to bringing this kind of change and this kind of pressure to Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 洛佩兹致力于将这种变革和压力带到委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: He's become mayor of a borough of Caracas.
sentences.zh: 他成为了加拉加斯一个区的区长。

sentences.en: Like, it's the Manhattan of Caracas.
sentences.zh: 就像是加拉加斯的曼哈顿。

sentences.en: It's the wealthiest and most prominent.
sentences.zh: 它是最富有、最显赫的地区。

sentences.en: And leading it is a very important position.
sentences.zh: 领导它是一个非常重要的职位。

sentences.en: It's a very useful stepping stone for a political career that would allow Leo Lopez ultimately to challenge Chavez for the presidency.
sentences.zh: 这是政治生涯中非常有用的垫脚石，最终让利奥·洛佩兹能够挑战查韦斯的总统职位。

sentences.en: And how is Leo as mayor?
sentences.zh: 利奥作为区长表现如何？

sentences.en: Leo's tenure as mayor is almost uniformly beloved by his constituents.
sentences.zh: 利奥的区长任期几乎受到了选民的一致爱戴。

sentences.en: In terms of the policy, policy, it's a sort of a mashup.
sentences.zh: 在政策方面，这是一种混合体。

sentences.en: So, on the one hand, he's jacking up corporate taxes and using the money for public works, building schools and rec centers and public parks.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他提高企业税，并将资金用于公共工程，建设学校、娱乐中心和公共公园。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, he's also adopting conservative models of policing and lowering the crime rate dramatically.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他也采用了保守的警务模式，大幅降低了犯罪率。

sentences.en: No faction of the city loved him more than the police department.
sentences.zh: 城市里没有哪个派别比警察部门更爱戴他了。

sentences.en: What it leads to is this sort of cartoonishly popular mayor.
sentences.zh: 这导致了一位漫画式受欢迎的区长。

sentences.en: I mean, he's known for showing up at crime scenes at two o'clock in the morning and standing there with his, you know, municipal police
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他以在凌晨两点出现在犯罪现场而闻名，穿着他的市政警察

sentences.en: jacket on, consulting with detectives in the blinking red lights and for throwing the first shovel of dirt groundbreaking ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 夹克，在闪烁的红灯下与侦探商议，并在奠基仪式上铲下第一锹土。

sentences.en: And then on weekends, you'd find him standing on a bench in some plaza with a megaphone, shouting at a crowd and encouraging them to nonviolent protests.
sentences.zh: 周末，你会发现他站在某个广场的长椅上，拿着扩音器，对着人群大喊，鼓励他们进行非暴力抗议。

sentences.en: So, you've got to understand that Leo loves Venezuela in a way that most people in most countries probably can't relate to.
sentences.zh: 所以，你必须明白，利奥对委内瑞拉的热爱是大多数国家的大多数人可能无法理解的。

sentences.en: And in fact, as mayor, he meets and falls in love with a Venezuelan woman named Lillian Tintori.
sentences.zh: 事实上，作为区长，他遇见并爱上了一位名叫莉莲·廷托里的委内瑞拉女性。

sentences.en: When he finally proposes to Lillian, he says to her,
sentences.zh: 当他最终向莉莲求婚时，他对她说：

sentences.en: this is my life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的生活。

sentences.en: I'm committed to Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 我致力于委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: And if you marry me, you're marrying Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 如果你嫁给我，你就是嫁给了委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: And she agrees to this.
sentences.zh: 她同意了。

sentences.en: And the wedding takes place before hundreds of people in a huge public park.
sentences.zh: 婚礼在一个巨大的公共公园里举行，数百人参加。

sentences.en: And it appears to a lot of people that they are becoming the future of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 在许多人看来，他们正在成为委内瑞拉的未来。

sentences.en: And so by the end of that term, he's got a 92 percent approval rating.
sentences.zh: 到任期结束时，他的支持率达到了92%。

sentences.en: And he's ranked by the city mayor's foundation as the third best mayor in the world.
sentences.zh: 他被城市市长基金会评为世界第三大最佳市长。

sentences.en: So it sounds like Leo is starting to gain some real stature and power and popularity.
sentences.zh: 听起来利奥开始获得真正的地位、权力和人气。

sentences.en: How does the Chavez regime, the government in power, respond to him becoming kind of an up-and-comer?
sentences.zh: 查韦斯政权，即当权政府，是如何应对他成为这种后起之秀的？

sentences.en: It becomes clear right away that his rising popularity is seen as a threat by Chavez and the Chavez government.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他日益增长的人气被查韦斯和查韦斯政府视为一种威胁。

sentences.en: And so Leo Lopez comes under an extraordinary number of both physical and administrative attacks.
sentences.zh: 因此，利奥·洛佩兹受到了大量身体和行政上的攻击。

sentences.en: Chavez had a number of armed loyalist groups who made three major attempts on Lopez's life between 2002 and 2006.
sentences.zh: 查韦斯拥有许多武装忠诚派团体，他们在2002年至2006年间曾三次试图暗杀洛佩兹。

sentences.en: In one case, shooting up his car and killing one of his bodyguards who died in Leo's arms that day.
sentences.zh: 其中一次，他们射击了他的汽车，打死了他的一名保镖，那天保镖死在了利奥的怀里。

sentences.en: And then on the administrative side, there was an accusation that came from the
sentences.zh: 而在行政方面，查韦斯政府指控他的预算有问题，

sentences.en: Chavez government that something in his budget was funny and he was spending money on the wrong parts of the municipal budget, which seems like a trivial detail.
sentences.zh: 说他把钱花在了市政预算的不当部分，这看起来是一个微不足道的细节。

sentences.en: But the decision was made by the Chavez government that this was important enough to ban Leo Lopez from seeking public office in the future.
sentences.zh: 但查韦斯政府决定，这足以禁止利奥·洛佩兹在未来寻求公职。

sentences.en: So the Chavez regime is attempting to kill him, it sounds like, through allies.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来查韦斯政权正试图通过盟友杀掉他。

sentences.en: And having failed to do that, decides to end his political career.
sentences.zh: 在未能做到这一点后，决定结束他的政治生涯。

sentences.en: Yes, it's the ban that has transformed his trajectory.
sentences.zh: 是的，正是这项禁令改变了他的轨迹。

sentences.en: But even after that, Leo's undeterred.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，利奥也并未退缩。

sentences.en: He continues taking to the streets constantly, rallying his supporters to protest the government through constant non-violent demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 他继续不断走上街头，号召支持者通过持续的非暴力示威来抗议政府。

sentences.en: At 4.25 today, on the 5th March, Hugo Chavez has died, after struggling with his illness for almost two years.
sentences.zh: 今天3月5日下午4点25分，雨果·查韦斯在与疾病抗争近两年后去世了。

sentences.en: 2013 is the year Hugo Chavez, who's been sick for quite a while at this point, finally succumbs and dies, and is replaced by his sort of hand-picked successor, Nicolás Maduro.
sentences.zh: 2013年，此时已经病了很久的雨果·查韦斯最终不治身亡，并由他钦定的继任者尼古拉斯·马杜罗接替。

sentences.en: Who takes power in lieu of Chavez, but has to run in order to remain in power.
sentences.zh: 他取代查韦斯掌权，但必须通过竞选才能维持权力。

sentences.en: And at this point, Leo Lopez is still banned from running, so he throws his support behind an opposition figure who challenges Maduro and comes one percentage point from winning.
sentences.zh: 此时，利奥·洛佩兹仍被禁止参选，因此他转而支持一位挑战马杜罗的反对派人物，该人物以一个百分点的差距落败。

sentences.en: A showdown may be looming in Venezuela after a disputed presidential election.
sentences.zh: 在一次有争议的总统选举后，委内瑞拉可能面临摊牌。

sentences.en: Prompting his challenger to demand a full recount.
sentences.zh: 促使他的挑战者要求全面重新计票。

sentences.en: We don't know if he really won the election by the votes, and people is getting tired about this government.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他是否真的在投票中获胜，人们对这个政府感到厌倦。

sentences.en: And Leo Lopez concludes that the election was stolen by Maduro.
sentences.zh: 利奥·洛佩兹断定选举是被马杜罗窃取的。

sentences.en: Right, just one point.
sentences.zh: 没错，就差一个百分点。

sentences.en: Just one point.
sentences.zh: 就差一个百分点。

sentences.en: And so it was entirely possible that even a small amount of electoral fraud could have tipped the election.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使是少量的选举舞弊也完全可能改变选举结果。

sentences.en: So what does Leo Lopez decide to do?
sentences.zh: 那么利奥·洛佩兹决定怎么做？

sentences.en: The big incident for Leo Lopez was on February 12th of 2014, when he led a rally of mostly students
sentences.zh: 利奥·洛佩兹的重大事件发生在2014年2月12日，当时他领导了一场主要由学生参加的集会，

sentences.en: near the university in Caracas advocating peaceful protests, saying over and over again we have to remain
sentences.zh: 在加拉加斯的大学附近倡导和平抗议，一遍又一遍地说我们必须保持

sentences.en: non-violent, reminding the crowd legitimacy would come through the non-violent element.
sentences.zh: 非暴力，提醒人群合法性将通过非暴力元素获得。

sentences.en: Anti-riot police formed a line, trying to stop the protesters from advancing.
sentences.zh: 防暴警察排成一线，试图阻止抗议者前进。

sentences.en: And he was able to keep the crowds peaceful, certainly when he was there.
sentences.zh: 当他在场时，他确实能够保持人群的和平。

sentences.en: And then he left, and the students marched on the office of the attorney general at the time, and began throwing rocks at the building.
sentences.zh: 然后他离开了，学生们游行到当时的司法部长办公室，开始向大楼投掷石块。

sentences.en: Which triggered an overreaction from security officers there.
sentences.zh: 这引发了那里安全官员的过度反应。

sentences.en: Two of the protesters were killed, and soon thereafter, the government announced that
sentences.zh: 两名抗议者被杀，此后不久，政府宣布

sentences.en: Leo Lopez was the instigator of all this trouble, and essentially responsible for the deaths, and that he would be prosecuted for terrorism and murder and things like that.
sentences.zh: 利奥·洛佩兹是所有这些麻烦的煽动者，本质上要对这些死亡负责，并将因恐怖主义、谋杀等罪名被起诉。

sentences.en: He went into hiding for several days, and during that period of hiding, he released a video
sentences.zh: 他躲藏了几天，在躲藏期间，他发布了一段视频，

sentences.en: declaring his innocence and his refusal to repent for anything he'd done, encouraging everyone to remain non-violent.
sentences.zh: 宣布自己无罪，拒绝为所做的一切忏悔，并鼓励大家保持非暴力。

sentences.en: And then ultimately...
sentences.zh: 然后最终……

sentences.en: Asking all of his supporters to come out to a downtown plaza in support of him.
sentences.zh: 呼吁他所有的支持者到市中心的广场来支持他。

sentences.en: And he wants him to dress all in white and gather to witness as he turns himself in to the government.
sentences.zh: 他希望支持者们都穿上白衣，聚集在一起，见证他向政府自首。

sentences.en: So he wakes up the morning of the rally, and gets on his motorcycle, and starts into the city.
sentences.zh: 集会那天早上，他醒来，骑上摩托车，向城里出发。

sentences.en: And he doesn't really know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 他其实并不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: He knows that he has a lot of supporters.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己有很多支持者。

sentences.en: He doesn't know how many are going to turn out.
sentences.zh: 但他不知道会有多少人出来。

sentences.en: He doesn't know if they're actually going to wear white, or what this is going to be like.
sentences.zh: 他不知道他们是否真的会穿白衣，也不知道现场会是什么样。

sentences.en: And he starts trying to find his way to the plaza.
sentences.zh: 他开始设法前往广场。

sentences.en: When he gets into the center of town, he begins to encounter all of this.
sentences.zh: 当他进入市中心时，他开始遇到这一切。

sentences.en: And he sees how extensive the response is, and was surprised at that point by how far the crowd extended.
sentences.zh: 他看到了民众的反应有多强烈，并对人群延伸的范围之广感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And he tries to find a way into the crowd, but he begins to encounter police barricades.
sentences.zh: 他试图挤进人群，但开始遇到警察设置的路障。

sentences.en: They're out looking for him.
sentences.zh: 他们正在搜捕他。

sentences.en: And he's trying to find his way around the barricades, and he gets a little closer, and then he gets a little closer.
sentences.zh: 他试图绕过路障，一点点靠近，再靠近。

sentences.en: But finally he concludes that he can't avoid all of the barricades, and that he's just going to have to take his chances at one.
sentences.zh: 但最终他断定自己无法避开所有的路障，只能在其中一个路障处碰碰运气。

sentences.en: So he pulls up to this one police barricade, and pauses for a second, and takes his helmet off.
sentences.zh: 于是他开到这个警察路障前，停顿了一秒，摘下头盔。

sentences.en: And these municipal cops from the borough where he had been mayor, all of whom are very fond of him,
sentences.zh: 这些来自他曾任市长的行政区的市政警察，他们都很喜欢他，

sentences.en: they looked at him, and one of them stiffens his spine, salutes, and waves him through to join his supporters.
sentences.zh: 他们看着他，其中一人挺直腰杆，敬了个礼，挥手让他通过，去与支持者汇合。

sentences.en: So he got off the bike and started wading toward this statue in the middle of the crowd.
sentences.zh: 于是他下了摩托车，开始向人群中间的一座雕像走去。

sentences.en: And he climbs up on the statue, and he faces out over this huge crowd in all directions.
sentences.zh: 他爬上雕像，面对着四面八方涌来的人群。

sentences.en: There's video of this online, and it is just staggering to behold the number of people.
sentences.zh: 网上有这段视频，看到那庞大的人数简直令人震惊。

sentences.en: It's tens upon tens of thousands.
sentences.zh: 那是成千上万的人。

sentences.en: And some people have put the number closer to 400,000 people, almost all dressed in white.
sentences.zh: 有些人估计人数接近40万人，几乎所有人都穿着白衣。

sentences.en: Someone hands him this bullhorn.
sentences.zh: 有人递给他一个扩音器。

sentences.en: Someone else gives him a Venezuelan flag, which he eventually wraps around his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 还有人给了他一面委内瑞拉国旗，他最后把它披在肩上。

sentences.en: And he starts calling out this message, and he says,
sentences.zh: 他开始喊出这条信息，他说，

sentences.en: This is for the youth who have no jobs, who have no future, who have no freedom.
sentences.zh: 这是为了那些没有工作、没有未来、没有自由的年轻人。

sentences.en: And he says, This democracy has failed, and if I'm going to have to go to jail for saying that,
sentences.zh: 他说，这个民主制度已经失败了，如果我因为说出这一点而必须入狱，

sentences.en: if my imprisonment helps to awaken the people, then it's worth the infamous punishment that's being handed down on me.
sentences.zh: 如果我的监禁能有助于唤醒民众，那么我所遭受的臭名昭著的惩罚就是值得的。

sentences.en: And then it's time for him to turn himself in.
sentences.zh: 然后，是他该自首的时候了。

sentences.en: So he climbs down from the pedestal, and there are members of the National Guard waiting there with a personnel transport vehicle.
sentences.zh: 他从底座上爬下来，国民警卫队的成员正带着一辆人员运输车在那里等着。

sentences.en: It sort of looks like a tank, but there's no gun on top, this big white truck.
sentences.zh: 那看起来有点像坦克，但上面没有炮，是一辆白色的大卡车。

sentences.en: And they escort him into the vehicle and are getting ready to drive off with him to take him to prison, and they can't go anywhere because the crowd has pressed in.
sentences.zh: 他们护送他进入车内，准备开车带他去监狱，但他们寸步难行，因为人群已经挤了过来。

sentences.en: That's also an extraordinary thing to watch.
sentences.zh: 那也是非常壮观的一幕。

sentences.en: You see just this mass of people clustered around to hold on to him and sort of embrace him in this moment, climbing over the tank, breaking bottles on it, rocking it.
sentences.zh: 你看到那一大群人聚在一起，想要留住他，在那一刻拥抱他，爬上坦克，在上面砸碎瓶子，摇晃着车身。

sentences.en: And it ends up taking three hours, during which time someone hands him another bullhorn inside this vehicle.
sentences.zh: 最终花了三个小时，期间有人在车内递给他另一个扩音器。

sentences.en: And he says, this is my decision.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是我的决定。

sentences.en: I want to go face this court of injustice.
sentences.zh: 我想去面对这个不公正的法庭。

sentences.en: I want this to happen so we can call attention to what's happening in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 我希望发生这一切，这样我们就能引起人们对委内瑞拉现状的关注。

sentences.en: Please make room to let us through.
sentences.zh: 请让出一条路让我们通过。

sentences.en: Please part the way for me.
sentences.zh: 请为我让开道路。

sentences.en: And slowly, sort of angrily, this crowd starts to pull back again, and a narrow path forms in front of the tank.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，带着某种愤怒，人群开始再次后退，坦克前方形成了一条狭窄的通道。

sentences.en: And once in a while you have somebody pop out from the crowd and still throw a bottle at the tank.
sentences.zh: 偶尔还会有人从人群中跳出来，向坦克扔瓶子。

sentences.en: But for the most part, this big truck starts moving slowly through the crowd to get to prison.
sentences.zh: 但大部分时间，这辆大卡车开始缓慢地穿过人群前往监狱。

sentences.en: So he's taken to prison.
sentences.zh: 于是他被带到了监狱。

sentences.en: What was the stated reason for his arrest, Will?
sentences.zh: 威尔，他被捕的既定理由是什么？

sentences.en: Well, he was initially charged with these crimes that were on the arrest warrant.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他最初被指控犯有逮捕令上的那些罪行。

sentences.en: Arson was in there.
sentences.zh: 其中包括纵火。

sentences.en: Terrorism was in there.
sentences.zh: 其中包括恐怖主义。

sentences.en: Murder was in there.
sentences.zh: 其中包括谋杀。

sentences.en: But the charges were scaled back pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 但指控很快就被缩减了。

sentences.en: And what he ended up being charged with was speech.
sentences.zh: 他最终被指控的罪名是言论。

sentences.en: No one accused him of doing anything violent.
sentences.zh: 没有人指控他做了任何暴力行为。

sentences.en: And in fact, no one accused him of saying that anyone else should do anything violent.
sentences.zh: 事实上，也没有人指控他曾要求任何人做任何暴力行为。

sentences.en: What he was accused of doing was sending coded subliminal messages.
sentences.zh: 他被指控的是发送了隐晦的潜意识信息。

sentences.en: In other words, subliminal, in peers in the indictment.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，起诉书中出现了“潜意识”这个词。

sentences.en: Within all of his calls for nonviolent protest, these subliminal messages were secretly telling his supporters and followers to be violent.
sentences.zh: 在他所有呼吁非暴力抗议的言论中，这些潜意识信息在秘密地告诉他的支持者和追随者去实施暴力。

sentences.en: And when they became violent, it was because they had received these subliminal messages from him.
sentences.zh: 当他们变得暴力时，那是因为他们收到了他发出的这些潜意识信息。

sentences.en: And they ended up with more than 150 witnesses coming to the stand,
sentences.zh: 最终有超过150名证人出庭，

sentences.en: a great number of whom testified that, in fact, they had received these subliminal messages from Leo Lopez instructing them to be violent.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分人作证说，他们确实收到了莱奥·洛佩兹发出的指示他们实施暴力的潜意识信息。

sentences.en: So Leo is taken to prison.
sentences.zh: 于是莱奥被带到了监狱。

sentences.en: He's taken to a military prison outside of Caracas.
sentences.zh: 他被带到了加拉加斯外的一所军事监狱。

sentences.en: He's locked up in a discreet building with no one else in it.
sentences.zh: 他被关在一栋隐蔽的建筑里，里面没有其他人。

sentences.en: He's the only prisoner.
sentences.zh: 他是唯一的囚犯。

sentences.en: And he's prohibited from granting interviews.
sentences.zh: 而且他被禁止接受采访。

sentences.en: At first, he's allowed to have books and things like that.
sentences.zh: 起初，他被允许拥有书籍之类的东西。

sentences.en: But over time, those are removed.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，这些也被没收了。

sentences.en: And he's forbidden to have them or to have pencils and pens and paper.
sentences.zh: 他被禁止拥有书籍，也不准使用铅笔、钢笔和纸。

sentences.en: But he insists on getting messages of dissent out from the prison.
sentences.zh: 但他坚持要从监狱里传出异议的信息。

sentences.en: At one point, he smuggles a video camera into his cell
sentences.zh: 有一次，他把一台摄像机偷运进牢房，

sentences.en: and records a message for the Venezuelan people and has it smuggled back out and posted online.
sentences.zh: 录下了一条给委内瑞拉人民的信息，并让人偷运出去发布在网上。

sentences.en: En paz y en democracia.
sentences.zh: 在和平与民主之中。

sentences.en: He smuggles out little scraps of paper with messages that get posted online to the public.
sentences.zh: 他把写有信息的小纸条偷运出去，发布在网上供公众阅读。

sentences.en: He'll sometimes climb up to this window that's way up high in his cell and hang from the bars of the window and scream about the need for democracy and liberty.
sentences.zh: 他有时会爬到牢房高处的一个窗户，挂在窗户的栏杆上，大声疾呼对民主和自由的需求。

sentences.en: And people would occasionally go to the outside of this military base and listen to Leopoldo Lopez screaming about democracy from the window of his cell in this concrete tower.
sentences.zh: 人们偶尔会走到这个军事基地的外面，听着莱奥波尔多·洛佩兹在混凝土塔楼的牢房窗户里大声呼喊民主。

sentences.en: The Venezuelan opposition leader Leopoldo Lopez has been moved to house arrest after more than three years in jail.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉反对派领导人莱奥波尔多·洛佩兹在入狱三年多后已被转为软禁。

sentences.en: At a certain point last year in the summer, he's released to house arrest under the condition that he'd fall completely silent and give no more messages to his supporters.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天某个时候，他被获准软禁，条件是他必须彻底保持沉默，不再向支持者传递任何信息。

sentences.en: He gets to his house and immediately records a video message which he releases to the public encouraging resistance to the government.
sentences.zh: 他回到家后立即录制了一段视频信息发布给公众，鼓励人们反抗政府。

sentences.en: And then he goes into the backyard and climbs up on a fence
sentences.zh: 然后他走到后院爬上栅栏，

sentences.en: and screams and waves his fist at a gathering crowd rallying them in the street.
sentences.zh: 对着聚集的人群挥舞拳头大喊大叫，在街上召集他们。

sentences.en: This is basically on day one of his house arreSt.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是在他被软禁的第一天。

sentences.en: It's within days, yeah.
sentences.zh: 就在几天之内，是的。

sentences.en: He's absolutely adamant that he won't be silenced.
sentences.zh: 他非常坚决，绝不会被噤声。

sentences.en: And so they take him back to prison.
sentences.zh: 于是他们又把他带回了监狱。

sentences.en: And they keep him there for a few days.
sentences.zh: 他们把他关在那里几天。

sentences.en: And he's treated even worse this time.
sentences.zh: 这次他受到的待遇更糟糕。

sentences.en: He's put into basically the hole.
sentences.zh: 他基本上被关进了黑牢。

sentences.en: Solitary confinement, in darkness, with very little food and water.
sentences.zh: 单独监禁，在黑暗中，几乎没有食物和水。

sentences.en: And the food that he's given is contaminated with feces from the scent of it.
sentences.zh: 而且他得到的食物从气味上判断是沾染了粪便的。

sentences.en: This is much worse treatment, even than the worst treatment he received in his three and a half years of imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 这种待遇比他在三年半监禁期间受到的最坏待遇还要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: And he goes into a deep, dark place.
sentences.zh: 他陷入了一个深沉、黑暗的境地。

sentences.en: So as he returns home a few days later, he's returned to house arrest, aware that the government is feeling emboldened.
sentences.zh: 几天后他回到家，再次被软禁，意识到政府正感到有恃无恐。

sentences.en: The punishment is getting more extreme.
sentences.zh: 惩罚变得越来越极端。

sentences.en: The police are now killing protesters in the streets in a way that they never have before.
sentences.zh: 警察现在在街上杀害抗议者，手段前所未有。

sentences.en: The government is also picking up elected officials, politicians, taking them hostage, and in many cases, disappearing them.
sentences.zh: 政府还在抓捕民选官员和政客，把他们当作人质，在许多情况下，让他们人间蒸发。

sentences.en: So all this is escalating at the time Leo returns home.
sentences.zh: 所以当莱奥回到家时，这一切都在升级。

sentences.en: And he has a decision to make.
sentences.zh: 他必须做出一个决定。

sentences.en: He really wants to continue speaking.
sentences.zh: 他真的很想继续发声。

sentences.en: He does not want to be silenced.
sentences.zh: 他不想被噤声。

sentences.en: He thinks it would set a bad example.
sentences.zh: 他认为这会树立一个坏榜样。

sentences.en: He thinks it would be an indignity to himself personally and violate his own principles.
sentences.zh: 他认为这对他个人来说是一种侮辱，也违背了他自己的原则。

sentences.en: But he knows that if he says anything at this point, he will be punished again.
sentences.zh: 但他知道，如果他现在说任何话，他会再次受到惩罚。

sentences.en: He's sure of it.
sentences.zh: 他对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: And so the question he faces is whether or not to take that risk.
sentences.zh: 所以他面临的问题是是否要冒这个险。

sentences.en: And for the first time ever, this irrepressible vocal figure falls entirely silent and issues no messages and is not seen,
sentences.zh: 这是有史以来第一次，这位不可抑制的呼声人物完全沉默了，没有发布任何信息，也没有露面，

sentences.en: leaving his supporters truly bewildered about what's happened to this guy.
sentences.zh: 让他的支持者们对这个家伙到底发生了什么感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: Did he abandon them?
sentences.zh: 他抛弃他们了吗？

sentences.en: Did he betray them?
sentences.zh: 他背叛他们了吗？

sentences.en: Is he just so defeated?
sentences.zh: 他只是太受挫了吗？

sentences.en: Has he given up on them?
sentences.zh: 他放弃他们了吗？

sentences.en: And should they give up on him?
sentences.zh: 他们应该放弃他吗？

sentences.en: But even though he hasn't been speaking publicly...
sentences.zh: 但尽管他一直没有公开讲话……

sentences.en: Hey, Will.
sentences.zh: 嘿，威尔。

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: He has actually been talking to me this whole time.
sentences.zh: 其实这段时间他一直都在跟我交谈。

sentences.en: Just all right, huh?
sentences.zh: 还行吧，是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Can you hear me okay?
sentences.zh: 你能听清我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I can hear you okay.
sentences.zh: 是的，我能听清。

sentences.en: All right, I just can't.
sentences.zh: 好的，我只是……

sentences.en: So Leo knows he has one more opportunity to speak before he will be taken back in and face even greater punishment.
sentences.zh: 所以莱奥知道，在被带回去面临更严厉的惩罚之前，他还有最后一次发声的机会。

sentences.en: And who knows what that will look like.
sentences.zh: 谁知道那会是什么样子。

sentences.en: So he chooses this.
sentences.zh: 所以他选择了这个。

sentences.en: This is the opportunity he takes to speak out.
sentences.zh: 这是他抓住机会发声的时刻。

sentences.en: What Leo Lopez has been saying and why he's talking.
sentences.zh: 莱奥·洛佩兹一直在说什么，以及他为什么要说话。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他新闻。

sentences.en: I may leave fast or we may sit down and make the greatest deal for the world and for all of these countries, including, frankly, North Korea.
sentences.zh: 我可能会很快离开，或者我们可能会坐下来，为世界和所有这些国家，坦率地说包括朝鲜，达成最伟大的协议。

sentences.en: And that's what I hope happens.
sentences.zh: 这就是我希望发生的事情。

sentences.en: During a rally in Pennsylvania on Saturday night, President Trump defended his surprise plan to meet with North Korean dictator Kim Jong-un,
sentences.zh: 周六晚上在宾夕法尼亚州的一次集会上，特朗普总统为他计划与朝鲜独裁者金正恩会面的突发计划进行了辩护，

sentences.en: whose name was booed by a skeptical crowd of Trump supporters.
sentences.zh: 当提到他的名字时，现场持怀疑态度的特朗普支持者发出了嘘声。

sentences.en: South Korea came to my office after having gone to North Korea and seeing Kim Jong-un.
sentences.zh: 韩国在去过朝鲜并见过金正恩之后来到了我的办公室。

sentences.en: And, no, it's very positive, no.
sentences.zh: 而且，不，这非常积极，不。

sentences.en: After the meeting, you may do that, but now we have to be very nice because let's see what happens.
sentences.zh: 会面之后，你可能会那样做，但现在我们必须表现得非常友善，让我们看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: Let's see what happens.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: The Times is reporting that Trump accepted North Korea's invitation to meet on the spot last Thursday after a visiting diplomat from South Korea told the president that Kim himself had said Trump's presence at a meeting could produce a historic breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，上周四，在一位韩国外交官告诉总统金正恩本人曾表示特朗普出席会面可能会产生历史性突破后，特朗普当场接受了朝鲜的会面邀请。

sentences.en: The snap decision reportedly shocked the South Korean envoy, as well as President Trump's defense secretary and national security advisor, who were all in the room.
sentences.zh: 据报道，这一突发决定震惊了韩国特使，以及当时在场的所有特朗普国防部长和国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: This doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 这不可能发生。

sentences.en: You know, they're saying, oh, well, Obama could have done that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们说，哦，好吧，奥巴马本可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: Trust me, he couldn't have done that.
sentences.zh: 相信我，他做不到。

sentences.en: He wouldn't have done that.
sentences.zh: 他不会那样做的。

sentences.en: He would not have done it.
sentences.zh: 他绝不会那样做。

sentences.en: And by the way, neither would Bush and neither would Clinton.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，布什和克林顿也不会。

sentences.en: And they had their shot and all they did was nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们曾经有机会，但什么都没做。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假日待客指南。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们睡觉时需要完全遮光吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种喝断片儿了才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或任何您喜欢的播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
